concepts.quote: for x = 0, B gives 1 because x >= 0 is true
concepts.why: The answer evaluates 0 >= 0 as true, which is right, but it ignores the inner x > 0 (false), so B actually stores 0 and A and B always agree. This is a slip in the trace.
The answer states no assignment rule. It only claims a wrong value for y (1 instead of 0).
